quotations.old_english: Gesiht, and gehérnes, and gefrédnes ongitaþ ðone líchoman dæs monnes
quotations.english: sight, and hearing, and feeling perceive the body of the man

source_text: ge-frédnes, -ness, e; f. A feeling, sense, perception; sensus :-- Gesiht, and gehérnes, and gefrédnes ongitaþ ðone líchoman dæs monnes sight, and hearing, and feeling perceive the body of the man, Bt. 41, 4; Fox 252, 7, 10.
